name: Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy
definition: Inherited muscular dystrophy characterized by facial weakness, scapular winging and humeral/upper-limb weakness with variable lower-limb involvement.

redFlags.item: Severe pain or atypical sensory loss

investigations.principle: Genetic testing confirms typical disease; pulmonary function is assessed in higher-risk patients.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Scapular fixation is selective for carefully chosen patients.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Bala-kshaya phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Inherited muscular dystrophy characterized by facial weakness, scapular winging and humeral/upper-limb weakness with variable lower-limb involvement.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
